questions.stem: 相較於傳統運動員，電競選手（esports players）最需要的不是體力，而是快速反應與團隊合作能力。
questions.answer: Compared with traditional athletes, what esports players need most is not physical strength but quick reactions and the ability to work in teams.
accepted_answers: Compared to traditional athletes, what esports players need the most is not physical strength but fast reactions and teamwork skills.
In comparison with athletes in traditional sports, what esports players need most is not physical strength but the ability to react quickly and cooperate with teammates.

patterns: what 名詞子句當主詞（最需要的…）

questions.stem: 在為重要比賽做準備時，職業選手往往每天練習十個小時，是一般玩家的三倍。
questions.answer: When preparing for an important competition, professional players often practice ten hours a day, three times as long as ordinary players.
accepted_answers: While preparing for an important match, professional players often practice for ten hours every day, which is three times as long as ordinary players do.
When getting ready for a big competition, professional players often train ten hours a day, three times as much as ordinary players do.

patterns: 倍數比較（three times as long as）

1.explanation_zh: 「相較於傳統運動員」用比較片語 Compared with／to traditional athletes 放句首（也可寫 athletes in traditional sports）。「電競選手最需要的」是整句的主詞，用 what 名詞子句 what esports players need most；what 子句當主詞視為單數，動詞用 is。「不是 A，而是 B」用 not A but B，兩邊都放名詞：「體力」是 physical strength（或 stamina），「快速的反應」是 quick reactions，「團隊合作能力」可寫 the ability to work in teams／as a team 或 teamwork skills。
evidence: 電競選手（esports players）最需要的
1.strategy_zh: 「相較於 N」→ Compared with／to + N；「…最需要的是…」→ What + S + need most + is …；「不是 A 而是 B」→ not A but B。
hints: 切成四段：相較於傳統運動員／電競選手最需要的／不是體力／而是快速反應與團隊合作能力
標的詞彙：compare（比較）、traditional（傳統的）、athlete（運動員）、need（需要）、physical（身體的）、strength（力量）、quick（快速的）、reaction（反應）、team（團隊）
句型框架：Compared with + N, what + S + need most + is not A but B

2.explanation_zh: 「在為重要比賽做準備時」省略的主詞就是後面的「職業選手」，用連接詞＋分詞 When preparing for an important competition（while preparing、when getting ready for 也可以）；「為…做準備」是 prepare for …，「比賽」可用 competition、match 或 tournament。「往往」用 often，放在一般動詞前。「每天練習十個小時」是 practice (for) ten hours a day／every day。「是一般玩家的三倍」補充說明練習時間，用倍數比較 three times as long as ordinary players (do)，也可以寫 , which is three times as long as …。
evidence: 在為重要比賽做準備時
2.strategy_zh: 「在…時」而且主詞相同 → When + V-ing …；「是…的 X 倍」→ X times as + 原級 + as …（不要寫 X times of）。
hints: 切成四段：在為重要比賽做準備時／職業選手往往／每天練習十個小時／是一般玩家的三倍
標的詞彙：prepare（準備）、important（重要的）、competition（比賽，也可用 match、tournament）、professional（職業的）、player（選手）、often（往往）、practice（練習）、hour（小時）、day（天）、ordinary（一般的）
句型框架：When V-ing …, S + often practice ten hours a day, three times as long as + N

traps.zh: 電競選手（esports players）最需要的
traps.literal_error: Esports players need most is not physical strength …
traps.explanation_zh: 中文「…最需要的」直接當主詞，英文要用 what 名詞子句 what esports players need most 當主詞，不然一句會有兩個動詞。
「體力」是複合概念，英文用 physical strength 或 stamina，不要逐字拆成 body power。

bonus.text: Compared with traditional athletes, it is not physical strength but lightning-fast reactions and seamless teamwork that esports players need most.
bonus.explanation_zh: It is … that …（強調句）把「不是體力，而是…」放到焦點位置；lightning-fast（快如閃電的）、seamless（天衣無縫的）是生動的形容。強調句只是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

1.restructuring_zh: 「…最需要的不是 A，而是 B」中文以「最需要的」當主題，英文改成 what 名詞子句當主詞（what esports players need most），再用 not A but B 對稱連接；「團隊合作能力」可寫成 the ability to work in teams／as a team，或濃縮成 teamwork skills。

common_errors.right: three times as long as ordinary players
common_errors.explanation_zh: 「是…的三倍」不能直譯成 three times of …；倍數比較寫 three times as long as …（或 three times longer than …）。

common_errors.wrong: three times as longer as ordinary players
common_errors.right: three times as long as ordinary players
common_errors.explanation_zh: as … as 中間用原級 long，不用比較級。

common_errors.wrong: three times long as ordinary players
common_errors.right: three times as long as ordinary players
common_errors.explanation_zh: 倍數的原級比較是 X times + as + 原級 + as，第一個 as 不能省略。

traps.zh: 在為重要比賽做準備時
traps.literal_error: When prepare for an important competition, professional players …
traps.explanation_zh: 「在為…做準備時」沒寫主詞，主詞就是後面的職業選手；英文用「連接詞＋分詞」When preparing for …，when 後面不能直接放原形動詞。

traps.literal_error: …, is three times of ordinary players.
traps.explanation_zh: 「是…的三倍」照字面譯成 is three times of … 是中式英文；英文的倍數比較寫 three times as long as …，或 three times longer than …。

bonus.text: So hard do professional players train before a big competition that they often practice ten hours a day, three times as long as ordinary players.
bonus.explanation_zh: So + 副詞 + 助動詞 + 主詞 … that …（倒裝）強調「練得多勤」。倒裝只是加分寫法，不是唯一正解。

2.restructuring_zh: 「是一般玩家的三倍」沒有說是什麼的三倍，英文要補成倍數比較 three times as long as ordinary players (do)，接在「每天練習十個小時」後面當補充說明（也可寫 , which is three times as long as …）。

1.translation: Compared with traditional athletes, what esports players need most is not physical strength but quick reactions and teamwork skills.
1.explanation_zh: 「相較於」用 Compared with（也可 Unlike）；「最需要的」用 what 名詞子句 what esports players need most 當主詞；「不是…而是…」用 not A but B；「快速反應與團隊合作能力」譯 quick reactions and teamwork skills（「能力」也可理解成兩者共用，譯 the ability to react quickly and work as a team）。

2.translation: When preparing for important competitions, professional players often practice ten hours a day, which is three times as long as ordinary players do.
2.explanation_zh: 「在為…做準備時」主詞同主要子句，用分詞化副詞子句 When preparing for…；「往往每天練習十個小時」用 often practice ten hours a day；「是一般玩家的三倍」補充說明練習時數，用 , which is three times as long as ordinary players do（倍數＋as…as，句尾加 do 讓比較的對象是練習時間而不是人）。

1.translation: Compared with traditional athletes, what esports players need most is not physical strength but quick reactions and the ability to work as a team.
1.explanation_zh: 「相較於傳統運動員」用 Compared with traditional athletes 當句首片語。「最需要的不是……而是……」用 what esports players need most is not A but B 的名詞子句當主詞，not A but B 對應「不是……而是……」。「體力」譯成 physical strength。「快速反應與團隊合作能力」譯成 quick reactions and the ability to work as a team；這裡中文「能力」可能只修飾團隊合作，也可能兩者都修飾，但用這個譯法兩種讀法都說得通。

2.translation: When preparing for important competitions, professional players often practice ten hours a day, which is three times as long as ordinary gamers do.
2.explanation_zh: 「在為重要比賽做準備時」用 When preparing for important competitions（省略 they are 的分詞構句，主詞與主要子句相同）。「往往每天練習十個小時」用 often practice ten hours a day，一般習慣用現在式。「是一般玩家的三倍」用 which is three times as long as ordinary gamers do 的倍數比較，as ... as 的倍數放在前面；ordinary gamers do 補出省略的 practice 以避免歧義。
